title: A smaller, costlier PC market means our store must win on AI discovery
summary: Asus sees the 2027 PC market shrinking 10-15% on memory prices; tablets fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia). Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries; OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet; JD.com bids for Ceconomy.

points.headline: PC demand is set to shrink as memory costs bite
points.detail: Asus expects the 2027 PC market down 10-15%; notebooks stay weak through Q2 2027 and tablets fell 23% in Q3. We should plan promo depth, mix and financing for a smaller market.

points.headline: AI assistants and agent payments are becoming the new storefront
points.detail: Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries and OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent checkout. We should check how our listings and checkout work for agents.

points.headline: Amazon and JD.com are reshaping electronics discovery and channels
points.detail: Amazon plans to catalog every product online and pushes AI personalization for Cyber 5; JD.com seeks Ceconomy. We should audit our Amazon listings and European channel exposure.

points.headline: Small-business buyers are spending, so lean into business offers
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers now.
